name: Vlado
summary: Vlado is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing and implements basic stop loss and take profit levels for trade management. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, placing trades when its trend conditions are met.
summary_zh: Vlado是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过均线交叉识别市场方向，并在趋势方向上开仓交易。它使用固定手数，并实现基本的止损和止盈水平进行交易管理。该EA系统性运行，无需人工干预，在趋势条件满足时自动下单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉来判断趋势方向。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时，产生做多信号；当快速均线向下穿越慢速均线时，产生做空信号。入场条件依赖于均线交叉的确认，属于典型的趋势跟随入场逻辑。出场条件采用固定止损和止盈点数，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理使用固定手数，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，缺乏基于风险百分比的仓位计算机制，存在过度暴露风险的可能性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossover of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. A buy signal is generated when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a sell signal when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Entry conditions rely on MA crossover confirmation, representing a classic trend-following entry logic. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit in points, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking risk-percentage-based position calculation, which may lead to overexposure risk.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势行情中表现良好
使用魔术编号区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Trend following strategy performs well in strong trending markets
Uses magic number to distinguish orders, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，资金利用效率低
均线交叉信号滞后，在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号
缺乏交易时间过滤和新增K线检查，可能同根K线重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, resulting in low capital efficiency
MA crossover signals are lagging, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Lacks trading session filter and new bar check, potentially opening duplicate trades on the same bar
improvements: 增加基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数
添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少虚假信号交易
加入新增K线检查和交易时段过滤，避免重复开仓和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce false signal trades in ranging markets
Implement new bar check and trading session filter to avoid duplicate entries and low-liquidity period trading

risk_points: 固定手数不随账户规模调整，存在过度杠杆风险
缺乏新增K线检查可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓
均线交叉在震荡市中频繁发出虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adjust with account size, posing overleveraging risk
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate trade entries on the same bar
MA crossover frequently generates false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses

summary_en: Vlado is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing and implements basic stop loss and take profit levels for trade management. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, placing trades when its trend conditions are met.
